Companion Animal Travel Desk: Pet Travel Guidance for Aurelia Skyways

Travel with a companion animal can be smooth when you know what to expect before you arrive. The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways gives travelers clear guidance so pets, crates, and documents are handled with care and with as little stress as possible.

Please check that your pet carrier is clean, secure, and roomy enough for the animal to stand and turn around. Bring any health records or travel approvals you have been told to carry, and keep them easy to reach at check-in. If your journey includes a comfort stop or a transfer, plan for your pet's needs in advance so you can move through the airport calmly.

Some skyports provide dedicated spaces for pet comfort, and staff can direct you to the right area when you arrive. <<FACT F003>> When a pet needs extra observation, follow the instructions from the care team and keep the carrier closed unless you are told otherwise. <<FACT F028>> If your route includes a relief area, listen for the local access guidance and use it exactly as directed. <<FACT F014>>

If you are traveling with a nervous animal, stay close, speak softly, and avoid rushing through the terminal. Small routines, like offering water at the right moment and keeping favorite bedding nearby, can make the trip easier for both you and your pet. Travellers such as Mariam Santos and Sara Martin often find that a simple plan helps them stay organized from the start of the journey to boarding.

If you need more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk through Aurelia Skyways customer support before you travel.
